common.dragAdjustHint: Drag to adjust · Ctrl+click to type
shell.resumeBlocked: Resumes automatically once you leave the duty
sell.title: Sell
sell.subtitle: Your retainers' listings and the plan for the next run.
sell.empty: Nothing planned yet. Your retainers' listings and the next run's plan will show up here.
plan.watchHelp: The undercut watch checks your listings against Universalis every {0} minutes, with no game request.
plan.onlyNeededHelp: Click to choose for the next run. On, the run visits only the retainers with an undercut listing, a lot to list or a listing to return. Settings, Assist and watch, hold the default.
plan.watchOffHelp: The undercut watch is off, so listings are checked against Universalis only when the plan refreshes. Turn it on under Settings, Assist and watch.
plan.refreshHelp: Read your bags again and fetch fresh Universalis prices for every item in the plan.
plan.refreshNoWorld: Prices are fetched for your home world once you are logged in
plan.dryRunHelp: Runs go to the bell, compare prices and record what they would change; nothing is typed, listed or repriced. Click to turn it off.
plan.dryRunOffHelp: Runs reprice and list for real, within your rules, floors and caps. Click to turn the dry run back on.
plan.dryRunConfirmBody: Every run after this types prices and presses Confirm at your retainers, within your rules, floors and caps.
plan.strip.gilNearCap: This retainer's gil is close to 999,999,999. Gil past the cap is lost, so no new listing goes to it.
plan.strip.toggleHelp: Include this retainer in runs. A retainer left out keeps its listings and is not visited.
plan.strip.locked: Stop the run to change this.
plan.column.currentHelp: The listing's price at the last bell visit.
plan.column.suggestedHelp: The price the run would set. Before the run it is an estimate from Universalis; the run compares prices at the board before it decides.
plan.column.referenceHelp: The average price of recent sales of this quality on your world, or on your data center when your world has none.
plan.group.vendor: To the vendor, through a retainer
plan.group.notVisited: Visit a bell to read this retainer's listings
plan.done.rejectedReason: The listing did not change after Confirm
plan.done.unknownReason: Not confirmed; answer the question on the Sell page
plan.done.cancelledReason: Cancelled before Confirm; nothing was changed
plan.done.promptRefusedReason: The retainer's gil limit question was answered No; nothing was changed
plan.done.help: Decided by the run at the board.
plan.reason.noCompetition: No other seller, priced at the reference
plan.reason.belowFloorListedAtFloor: Below floor, listed at the floor
plan.reason.overStepLimit: Over the step limit, needs approval
plan.reason.unknownCompetition: No usable market data yet, kept
plan.reason.notEligible: No rule of yours covers it
plan.placement.noMarket: No retainer can list it yet
plan.placement.ownerUnavailable: Its retainer is not in this run
plan.moveRefused: The chosen retainer cannot take it, so it is placed by value
plan.skip.rowNotFound: Not found among the retainer's listings
plan.skip.windowDidNotOpen: The sell window did not open
plan.skip.windowMismatch: The sell window showed something else
plan.skip.quantity: The quantity is outside the window's limits
plan.skip.readBackUnavailable: The listings or the bag slot could not be read before the change, so nothing was typed
plan.skip.inSaddlebag: Still in the saddlebag: a run moves it to your bags before the bell when they have room
plan.skip.refused: A safety check refused it; the Console has the details
plan.edit.belowFloor: That is below this row's floor of {0}.
plan.edit.outOfRange: Enter a price from 1 to 999,999,999 gil.
plan.edit.locked: Stop the run to edit the plan.
plan.approveHelp: Let this listing drop from {0} to {1} once. The approval covers that price only.
plan.tile.valueHelp: The value of every listing the run would put up or reprice, at its new price.
plan.tile.vendorHelp: Gil from vendoring junk through your retainers. Vendoring is not part of runs yet.
plan.tile.timeHelp: Searches at the pacing floor, the window steps and the switches between retainers, without the walk to the bell.
plan.empty.loggedOut: Log in to see the plan.
plan.empty.noRetainers: Open a summoning bell once so Auto Seller can read your retainers.
plan.empty.firstVisit: Visit a bell once to read your listings.
plan.finished.title: Last run
plan.finished.dismissHelp: Hide this card and the run's results in the table. History keeps every run.
plan.needs.title: The run needs you
plan.failed.title: The run failed
listings.title: Listings
listings.subtitle: Every listing of every character, from each retainer's last visit.
listings.stateHelp.lowest: Universalis shows no lower price of another seller on your world.
listings.stateHelp.undercut: Universalis shows a lower price on your world, newer than this listing's last reprice.
listings.stateHelp.belowFloor: The price is under the item's floor.
listings.stateHelp.priceWar: Repriced down too often lately; runs leave it alone until the price war window passes.
listings.stateHelp.sold: A sale notice or the retainer's sale history shows this listing sold after the retainer's last visit; the next visit takes it off.
listings.stateHelp.noData: Universalis cannot tell whether another seller is lower: it has no recent data for this item on this character's home world, its data is older than the last reprice, or its lowest price is one of yours.
listings.listedHelp: How long the listing has been up, counted from the first bell visit that saw it. A reprice does not reset it.
listings.lastRepriceHelp: How long ago a run last changed this price.
listings.competitorHelp: The lowest price of another seller on your world in the latest Universalis data.
listings.empty: No listings yet. Visit a summoning bell with each character once.
sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: What your retainers sold, from sale notices in chat, the retainers' sale histories and listings gone between visits.
sales.loading: Reading the sales of every character…
sales.empty: No sales recorded yet. They show up once a sale notice arrives in chat or a run reads a retainer's sale history.
sales.tile.help: Gil after the seller fee of each retainer's city, from the sales of every character.
sales.chart.title: Gil per day, last 30 days
sales.hints.title: Hints
sales.hints.quick: {0} sold {1} after it was listed; consider raising its price.
sales.hints.stale: {0} has sat unsold at the lowest price for {1}.
sales.onMarketHelp: How long the item's listings sat on the market before they sold, on average, where the listing time is known.
sales.netHelp: Gil after the seller fee of the retainer's city.
sales.listingsHelp: Listings in use at the last visit.
sales.source.notice: Read from a sale notice in chat.
sales.source.history: Read from the retainer's sale history.
sales.source.diff: The listing was gone at the next visit and no run took it off, so it is counted as sold.
sales.gil.corroborated: The retainer's gil grew by at least the take of the sales inferred at that visit.
sales.gil.partial: The retainer's gil grew, but by less than the take of the sales inferred at that visit.
sales.gil.uncorroborated: The retainer's gil did not grow between the two visits, so this sale may not have happened.
sales.gil.atCap: The retainer's gil was at its cap, so its growth cannot confirm this sale.
sales.noRows: Nothing sold in the last 30 days.
sales.exportHelp: Write every recorded sale to a CSV file in the plugin's folder, without character, retainer or buyer names.
sales.exportFailed: The CSV could not be written: {0}
dock.reason.journal: answer the card on the Sell page first
run.chat.taskFailed: A task could not be started. The log has the details.
run.status.preparing: Reading your bags and the reference prices
run.status.settling: Waiting for the stopped run to close its windows
run.status.lot: {0}: pricing {1} for a new listing ({2} of {3})
run.status.vendoring: {0}: having the retainer sell {1} to a vendor
run.status.saddlebag.one: Moving {0} stack from the saddlebag to your bags
run.status.saddlebag.other: Moving {0} stacks from the saddlebag to your bags
run.status.retainerPass: {0}: selling from the retainer's own inventory
run.status.pausedInContent: Paused while you are in content
run.status.pausedInterrupted: Paused: combat or a duty pop interrupted the run; it carries on once that is over
run.status.stopping: Stopping and closing the sell windows
run.status.done: Dry run done: {0} to reprice, {1} to list, {2} kept, {3} skipped
run.status.doneLive: Run done: {0} repriced, {1} listed, {2} kept, {3} skipped
run.block.notOnHomeWorld: Go back to your home world first; retainers only sell there.
run.block.inCutscene: Wait until the cutscene is over.
run.block.trading: Finish or cancel the trade first.
run.block.autoRetainerBusy: AutoRetainer is busy; wait until it is done.
run.block.autoRetainerNotHeld: AutoRetainer could not be held back for the run; try again, or reload AutoRetainer if this keeps happening.
run.block.protectListUnreadable: AutoRetainer cannot read its protect list for this character, so nothing is sold until it can. This happens when AutoRetainer has no data for the character; the Console has the details.
run.block.unresolvedJournal: A listing change from an earlier run is not settled yet; answer the question on the Sell page first.
run.block.gatesClosed: The market checks failed when the plugin loaded, so prices cannot be read this session. The Console has the details.
run.block.noRules: Add an item to the sell list or a category rule on the Rules page first.
run.block.noRetainers: No retainer is enabled. Open a summoning bell once so Auto Seller can read your retainers.
run.block.authorization: The run could not be authorized. The Console has the details.
run.block.nothingNeeded: No enabled retainer needs a visit: none has an undercut listing, a lot to list or a listing to return. Turn off Only retainers that need it on the Sell page to visit them all.
run.block.sellListNotOpen: Open a retainer's sell list first.
run.block.retainerNotEnabled: This retainer is not enabled on the Sell page.
run.needs.bellNotReached: no summoning bell could be reached; stand at one or in your inn room and press Start again
run.needs.windowsStuck: a retainer window did not open or close in time
run.needs.unexpectedWindow: a window the plugin did not open is in the way
run.needs.gilLimit: a retainer is close to its gil limit
run.needs.unknownWrite: a listing change from this run is not confirmed yet; answer the question on the Sell page
run.failed.fault: an unexpected error; the Console has the details
run.failed.otherCharacter: another character is logged in than the one the run started for
run.failed.menuText: the retainer menu text could not be read from the game data
run.failed.settingsChanged: the rules, the pricing settings or the plan edits changed after Start; start again to use them
run.failed.leftHomeWorld: the character left its home world
run.failed.dayChanged: the game day changed after Start; start again for the new day
run.failed.guard: a safety check refused the run's next step; the Console has the details
run.failed.journal: the journal could not be written, so nothing more is typed; the Console has the details
run.chat.started.one: Dry run started for {0} retainer: prices are compared and nothing is listed or repriced.
run.chat.started.other: Dry run started for {0} retainers: prices are compared and nothing is listed or repriced.
run.chat.startedLive.one: Run started for {0} retainer: listings are repriced and lots listed within your floors and caps.
run.chat.startedLive.other: Run started for {0} retainers: listings are repriced and lots listed within your floors and caps.
run.chat.faultRestart: The run stopped on an unexpected error; restarting it ({0} of {1}).

plugins.allInstalled: All required plugins are installed and loaded.

plugins.footer: Install adds the plugin's source repository to Dalamud and queues an install. If one-click install fails (URL drift, network), right-click a plugin name to copy its repo URL and add it manually via /xlsettings -> Experimental -> Custom Plugin Repositories.
plugins.purpose.vnavmesh: Pathfinding and movement for walking to a summoning bell.

log.title: Console
log.empty: Nothing logged yet. Start a run and every step the plugin takes shows up here.
log.noMatches: No lines match the current filters.
log.footer: Every line also goes to the Dalamud log (/xllog) with the {0} prefix. When reporting a bug, press Copy log and paste the result into the issue.
log.copyTooltip: Copies the lines shown below with a header naming the plugin version, Dalamud version and zone, ready to paste into a bug report.
log.levelTooltip: Click to show or hide these lines. Shift-click to show only this level.
log.sourceChipTooltip: Click to stop filtering by source.
log.shortcuts: Ctrl+F search · Ctrl+C copy · Shift-click selects a range · Double-click copies a line
log.copyToEnd: Copy from here to the end
log.hasDetails: Has a stack trace. Select the line to read it.
changelog.title: What's new
changelog.subtitle: Every update, newest first.
about.support.title: Made with love and care
about.support.body: This plugin is a one-person project, built in my free time because I love this game and its community. Keeping it updated takes a lot of those hours. If it has helped you, supporting me on Patreon or buying me a coffee means I can keep giving it that time. Thank you for being here.
about.support.coffeeHint: Open Buy Me a Coffee · right-click to copy
about.linkHint: Click to open · right-click to copy
about.discordBody: Get help, report bugs, share ideas and hear about updates first.
about.githubBody: Browse the source code and every release.
about.reminder.title: A little reminder
about.facts.title: Did you know?
about.quotes.title: Words to live by
about.jokes.title: Just for fun
about.reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
about.reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
about.reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
about.reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
about.reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
about.reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
about.reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
about.reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
about.reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
about.reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
about.reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
about.reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.
about.facts.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
about.facts.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
about.facts.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
about.facts.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
about.facts.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
about.facts.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
about.facts.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
about.facts.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
about.facts.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
about.facts.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
about.facts.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
about.quotes.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
about.quotes.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
about.quotes.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
about.quotes.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
about.quotes.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
about.quotes.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
about.quotes.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
about.quotes.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.
about.jokes.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
about.jokes.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
about.jokes.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
about.jokes.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
about.jokes.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
about.jokes.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
about.jokes.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
about.jokes.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
about.jokes.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
about.jokes.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: The language of this plugin's windows. Zone, item and world names always follow the game client.
settings.general.openOnLoginHelp: Pop the main window automatically the next time you log in.
settings.general.autoPauseHelp: Pause the run while you are inside a duty, trial, raid, or any other instanced content, then resume it once you are back outside. Your run and session stats are kept.
settings.general.pauseTypingHelp: While a text box of the game has focus, like the chat line, a run starts no new move until you close it. A move already under way carries on.
plugin.commandHelp: Toggle the Auto Seller window. /asell config | stats | deps | log | changelog | about | start (start the run) | stop (stop the run) | pause (pause or resume the run) | look <item id> (compare market prices once and log the price inputs) | mbstatus (log the market checks, the search state and the open retainer's market) | sendpath compare|proxy (send market searches through the sell window or the item search proxy).
plugin.configReset: Your settings could not be read, so Auto Seller started with default settings. The old file is kept as {0}.
plugin.configResetUnsaved: Your settings could not be read, so Auto Seller started with default settings. The old file could not be kept; the log has the details.
safety.tabSub: Detects nearby Game Masters and reacts: stop the run, ping you, or take more drastic action.
safety.gm.stopRunHelp: End the run at once when a GM appears nearby. Strongly recommended; the other alerts are little use if the run keeps going.
safety.gm.toastHelp: Pop a Dalamud toast: "GM <name> is nearby!"
safety.gm.chatHelp: Print a red chat warning into your local log.
safety.gm.soundHelp: Plays a series of system beeps through your speakers. Loud enough to grab your attention if you're tabbed away.
safety.gm.beepCountHelp: How many beeps to play in the burst.
safety.gm.commandsHelp: Chat commands to run when a GM is spotted. Useful for things like /logout, /sh stay calm, or a macro.
safety.gm.killHelp: Hard-terminate the game process via /xlkill. The last-resort option; no goodbyes, no cutscene, no logout. You'll get a disconnect.
humanizer.tabSub: Short random pauses before the run acts, the way a player reacts.
humanizer.enabledHelp: Wait a random moment before each action below, drawn anew each time between the shortest and the longest value. A shortest value above the longest is used as a fixed wait. Off acts at once.
humanizer.moveOffHelp: Before the run sets off toward its next stop, ahead of any teleport or move.
humanizer.teleportHelp: Before each teleport the run casts.
rules.title: Rules
rules.subtitle: What may be sold, what never is, and what goes to the vendor. Nothing is sold until a rule allows it.
rules.importHelp: Read rules exported from Auto Seller from the clipboard. You confirm before they replace yours.
rules.exportHelp: Copy every rule to the clipboard as JSON. Preferred retainers are left out.
rules.importEmpty: The clipboard is empty. Copy exported rules first.
rules.importTooLarge: The clipboard holds too much text to be a rules export.
rules.importMalformed: The clipboard does not hold rules exported from Auto Seller.
rules.importNewerVersion: These rules come from a newer version of Auto Seller. Update the plugin to import them.
rules.itemDataFailed: The item data could not be read. The log has the details.
rules.sell.searchHint: Add an item to sell, by name or id
rules.sell.empty: Nothing is sold until you add it here. Search for an item above.
rules.sell.footnote: Items in a gear set, equipped items and items AutoRetainer protects are never sold, whatever these rules say.
rules.sell.floorHelp: The lowest price per unit this item is ever listed at. Empty leaves the floor to the vendor price and the reference price.
rules.sell.ceilingHelp: The highest price per unit, used when competition is thin or absent. Empty means no ceiling.
rules.sell.fixedPriceHelp: List at this price per unit instead of the market price. The floor still applies.
rules.sell.lotSizeHelp: Units per listing. Empty lists whole stacks; a size such as 99 splits large stacks.
rules.sell.keepCountHelp: Units that always stay in your bags.
rules.sell.listingsToKeepUpHelp: How many listings of this item to keep up across all retainers, from 1 to 20. Each run tops them up from stock as they sell.
rules.sell.preferredRetainerHelp: The retainer this item goes to first when it has a free slot.
rules.sell.activeHelp: Turn off to pause this rule. A paused rule lists nothing new.
rules.sell.ceilingBelowFloor: The ceiling cannot be below the floor.
rules.cat.empty: No category rules yet. A category rule sells every item of its categories whose reference price reaches its minimum.
rules.cat.footnote: A category rule lists whole stacks, one listing per item and quality, and keeps nothing back. Use the sell list for anything that needs more control.
rules.cat.enabledHelp: A rule that is off matches nothing.
rules.cat.minimumHelp: Items whose reference price per unit is below this stay in your bags, so cheap materials are not listed by accident.
rules.cat.listHelp: The item categories this rule covers, as the game groups items.
rules.cat.noneChosen: Pick at least one category, or this rule matches nothing.
rules.never.searchHint: Add an item you never want sold
rules.never.empty: Items on this list are never listed or vendored, even when a rule matches them.
rules.never.footnote: The never-sell list wins over the sell list, the category rules and the vendor rules.
rules.vendor.enabledHelp: Sell junk to the NPC through your retainer. Only normal quality items from your bags that are not gear, not protected and not on the sell list are vendored.
rules.vendor.junkThresholdHelp: A stack is junk when its reference value, for the whole stack, is below this.
rules.vendor.capHelp: A run stops vendoring once the vendor price of what it sold would pass this.
rules.vendor.searchHint: Add an item to always vendor
rules.vendor.listEmpty: Items on this list are vendored even when they are not junk, as long as vendoring is on.
rules.vendor.footnote: Vendoring stays off until you turn it on. High quality items, gear and items AutoRetainer protects are never vendored.
rules.blocked.intro: Items in your bags that a rule matches but that will not be listed, and why.
rules.blocked.loggedOut: Log in to check your bags.
rules.blocked.none: Every matched item in your bags can be listed.
rules.reason.notMarketable: Not sold on the market board
rules.reason.belowCategoryMinimum: Reference price below the category minimum
rules.reason.qualityNotAllowed: Its rule does not cover this quality
rules.reason.noLot: Nothing left after the keep count and lot size
rules.hold.keptInBags: Kept in your bags by the keep count
rules.hold.belowLotSize: Less than one lot left after the keep count
rules.hold.listingsUp: Enough listings of it are up already
rules.hold.bagsFull: No free bag slot to take it out of the saddlebag
pricing.tabSub: How prices are chosen, how far one step may move them, and when a run holds back.
pricing.modeHelp: How a price is set against the lowest same-quality listing of another seller.
pricing.mode.undercutDetail: Go just below the lowest seller.
pricing.mode.matchDetail: List at the lowest seller's price.
pricing.undercutUnitHelp: A fixed amount of gil, or a percent of the lowest price rounded down. Never less than 1 gil.
pricing.unit.gilDetail: The same amount of gil for every item.
pricing.unit.percentDetail: A share of the lowest price, so dear items drop more.
pricing.undercutGilHelp: How many gil below the lowest seller a price goes, from 1 to 10,000.
pricing.undercutPercentHelp: How far below the lowest seller a price goes, from 0.1% to 10%.
pricing.referenceRatioHelp: Never list below this share of the reference price, the average of recent sales. The floor is never below the vendor price either.
pricing.baitRatioHelp: Ignore listings priced below this share of the reference price, so one troll listing does not set your price.
pricing.stepLimitHelp: The most one reprice may drop a price. A larger drop waits for your approval on the Sell page.
pricing.cooldownHelp: A listing is not repriced again until this long after its last reprice.
pricing.priceWarDropsHelp: Stop chasing a listing once it has dropped this many times inside the price war window, until the window passes.
pricing.priceWarWindowHelp: How far back the drops of a listing are counted.
pricing.raiseHelp: Raise a listing that sits far below the next seller, so it does not sell for less than the market pays.
pricing.raiseGapHelp: Raise only when the next seller is at least this much above your price.
pricing.maxRaiseHelp: The most one raise may add to a price. A listing below its floor is raised to the floor regardless.
pricing.belowFloorNewHelp: What happens to a new lot when the market price is below its floor.
pricing.belowFloorNew.keepDetail: Leave the lot in your bags until the market recovers.
pricing.belowFloorNew.listDetail: List the lot at its floor price anyway.
pricing.belowFloorListingHelp: What happens to a listing when the market stays below its floor.
pricing.belowFloorListing.keepDetail: Leave the listing at its price.
pricing.belowFloorListing.returnDetail: Take the listing back to the retainer once the market has stayed below its floor for 3 days.
pricing.dryRunHelp: Go through the whole run and record what it would change without typing a price. Turning it off asks first.
pricing.maxRepricesHelp: A run stops repricing after this many reprices. 0 turns repricing off.
pricing.maxListingsHelp: A run stops listing after this many new listings. 0 turns new listings off.
sources.tabSub: Where the items to sell come from. Your bags and crystals are always read.
sources.saddlebagHelp: List items from your chocobo saddlebag. A stack is moved to your bags first, only when there is room and only for a lot already planned for a retainer.
sources.armouryHelp: List items from the armoury chest. Items in any gear set are never sold.
sources.retainerHelp: Sell items stored in this retainer's inventory, read while the retainer is open.
sources.noRetainers: Visit a summoning bell once so your retainers show up here.
sources.loggedOut: Log in to choose which retainers' inventories to sell from.
sources.retainersFootnote: A retainer's inventory is read only while that retainer is open, during a run or when you open it yourself.
autoRetainer.tabSub: Work alongside AutoRetainer when it is installed.
autoRetainer.postprocessHelp: When AutoRetainer finishes a retainer's venture, reprice and list on that retainer before handing it back.
autoRetainer.sellNowHelp: Add a button to AutoRetainer's retainer list that sends every retainer through Auto Seller.
autoRetainer.sellNowTooltip: Auto Seller: reprice and list on each retainer now
autoRetainer.sellNowUnavailable: Off while AutoRetainer is outdated or not answering
autoRetainer.alts: Treat AutoRetainer characters as my alts
autoRetainer.altsHelp: Never undercut listings from the retainers of your other characters that AutoRetainer knows.
autoRetainer.footnote: These need AutoRetainer installed and up to date. Items AutoRetainer protects are never sold or vendored, whatever these switches say.
autoRetainer.stateHelp: Whether AutoRetainer answers. Outdated means Auto Seller runs only from Start and does not hold AutoRetainer back.
autoRetainer.altsKnownHelp: Your other characters that AutoRetainer knows, and their retainers, read again each time the plan is built.
autoRetainer.jobHelp: What Auto Seller is doing in AutoRetainer's venture cycle.
autoRetainer.job.stoodDown: Stopped by you at this bell
autoRetainer.held: AutoRetainer is held back until the current run ends.
assist.tabSub: Help when you list by hand, and keep an eye on undercuts.
assist.enabledHelp: When you open the sell window yourself, compare prices and fill in the suggested price with its reason. You press Confirm.
assist.skipKeyHelp: Hold this key while the sell window opens to skip Assist for that window.
assist.watchIntervalHelp: Check your listings against Universalis on a timer and mark the undercut ones. No game request is made.
assist.onlyNeededHelp: The default of the Sell page's run option: a run visits only the retainers with an undercut listing, a lot to list or a listing to return.
buttons.runAllHelpDryRun: Start a dry run over your enabled retainers from this list: prices are compared and nothing is typed.
buttons.runAllHelpLive: Start a run over your enabled retainers from this list: listings are repriced and lots listed within your floors and caps.
buttons.repriceRetainerHelpDryRun: Dry run this retainer from its open sell list: prices are compared, nothing is typed, and the sell list stays open.
buttons.repriceRetainerHelpLive: Reprice and list for this retainer from its open sell list, within your floors and caps; the sell list stays open.
saleHistory.readHelp: Open each retainer's sale history on every visit and record its sales, so sales made while you were away are counted.
saleHistory.footnote: Sale notices in chat and listings that disappear between visits are recorded either way.
market.look.usage: Usage: /asell look <item id>. Open that item's sell window at a retainer first, or use /asell sendpath proxy to search at a summoning bell or a market board.
market.look.loggedOut: Log in before looking up market prices.
market.look.busy: A task is running; stop it before looking up market prices.
market.look.readingOff: Market listings cannot be read this session. /asell mbstatus says why.
market.look.notMarketable: Item {0} is not sold on the market board.
market.look.noSellWindow: Open the sell window of {0} at a retainer first, or use /asell sendpath proxy to search through the item search proxy.
market.look.otherItem: The open sell window holds another item. Open the sell window of {0} first.
market.look.noCompareButton: The Compare prices button of the sell window was not found this session. /asell sendpath proxy searches without it.
market.look.notAtMarket: Stand at a summoning bell or open a market board before searching for {0}.
market.look.throughSellWindow: Comparing prices for {0} through the sell window. The Console lists the price inputs when it is done.
market.look.throughProxy: Searching the market for {0} directly. The Console lists the price inputs when it is done.
market.look.failure.proxyUnavailable: the market search is not available
market.look.failure.requestRefused: the game did not take the search
market.look.failure.snapshotMismatch: the listings read did not add up
market.look.failure.readingOff: listings cannot be read this session
market.look.done.one: Read {0} listing of {1}. The Console has the price inputs.
market.look.done.other: Read {0} listings of {1}. The Console has the price inputs.
market.status.summary: Market: reading listings {0}, reading the retainer market {1}, writing prices {2}. The Console has the details.
market.sendPath.usage: Usage: /asell sendpath compare | proxy. Market searches currently go through {0}.
market.sendPath.comparePrices: the Compare prices button of the sell window
market.sendPath.searchProxy: the item search proxy, at a summoning bell or a market board
market.historyPath.usage: Usage: /asell historypath window | packet. Retainer sale histories are currently read from {0}.
market.historyPath.set: Retainer sale histories are now read from {0}, from the next visit on.
market.historyPath.packet: the data the game receives for the Sale History window
journal.damagedTitle: The journal needs a fresh start
journal.damagedBody: The journal of listing changes holds lines that cannot be trusted, so no price is written. Set it aside to start a fresh one; the old file is kept beside it.
journal.unreadableBody: The journal of listing changes could not be read, so no price is written. The Console has the details.
journal.setAsideFailed: The journal could not be set aside; the Console has the details.
journal.listTitle: Did this listing go up at {0}?
journal.returnTitle: Did this listing go back to the retainer?
journal.vendorTitle: Did the retainer sell this stack for {0}?
journal.body: A run could not confirm this change after pressing Confirm, so no price is written until you answer. If you are not sure, look at the retainer's sell list at a summoning bell.
journal.moveTitle: Did this stack move from the saddlebag to your bags?
journal.moveBody: A run could not confirm this move from the saddlebag, so nothing more is written until you answer. If you are not sure, look in your bags and your saddlebag.
journal.moveHintApplied: Your bags now hold the stack.
journal.moveHintNotApplied: Your bags hold no more of it than before.
journal.moveHintUnclear: Your bags changed by another amount, so they cannot tell.
journal.moveHintNoRead: Your bags could not be read to suggest the answer.
journal.hintApplied: A later read of {0} shows the change went through.
journal.hintNotApplied: A later read of {0} shows no change.
journal.hintUnclear: A later read of {0} cannot tell.
journal.hintNoRead: Open the sell list of {0} at a summoning bell and it is read to suggest the answer.
journal.answerFailed: The answer could not be written to the journal; the Console has the details.
